The new way of typing with finger scope. Easier typing with the small smartphone keys with the patent pending TuneKey app. Easier typing is possible because of the new finger scope between the keys which above all can be enlarged. 

With the standard smartphone keys typing on the wrong key often happens, especially with larger fingers. This is because the touch surfaces, the active non-visible parts of the standard keys that are sensitive to touch, lie against each other. This is also the case when the standard keys are visually smaller. With TuneKey the touch surfaces of the smaller keys do not lie against each other. There is just space between the touch surfaces. In this way the fingers have scope around a key and hit much less a wrong key. The smaller the settings of the TuneKey keys the larger these finger scopes between the touch surfaces are. Then it is easier to type with smaller keys, especially with larger fingers. This is what TuneKey does remarkably better, confirmed with beta testers.

results.description:
Anything you type twice belongs in KeepText.

Addresses. Bank details. The reply you send five times a week. Prompts, code,
links, your kid's allergy list. Save it once — then paste it anywhere, without
leaving the app you're in.


THE KEEPTEXT KEYBOARD

This is the one that changes the day-to-day. Switch to the KeepText keyboard
inside Mail, Messages, WhatsApp, Safari, Slack — anywhere you can type. Your
snippets are right there, ordered by what you actually use, so the one you
want is usually the first one. Tap it and the text lands at your cursor.

No app switching. No back-and-forth copy and paste. No losing your place.


SAVE IT IN UNDER A SECOND

- Share sheet — select text in any app, tap Share, choose KeepText. Done.
- Clipboard — copy something, open KeepText, and it offers to save it. One tap
  to keep, one tap to dismiss. It never reads your clipboard until you say yes.
- Type it — one field does both jobs. Search your library, and if nothing
  matches, that same field creates the snippet on the spot.


ONE TAP AWAY, EVERYWHERE ELSE TOO

- Widgets — home screen and lock screen. Tap to copy.
- Spotlight — swipe down anywhere and search your snippets by name.
- Shortcuts and Siri — "Save clipboard to KeepText," or add it to your Action
  button for one-press capture.


SEARCH THAT TELLS YOU THE TRUTH

Most apps guess. KeepText matches exactly — the word you typed, or the start
of it, and nothing looser. That sounds like a limitation until you use it: when
KeepText says nothing matched, it genuinely isn't saved yet, so you can create
it right there instead of wondering whether you're about to make a duplicate.


TEMPLATES

Put {{name}} or {{date}} anywhere in a snippet. When you use it, KeepText asks
you for the values and fills them in. Good for the email you send constantly
with one line that changes.


SYNCS EVERYWHERE. NO ACCOUNT. EVER.

Your snippets sync across your devices through your own iCloud account. There
is no KeepText account, no sign-up, no password, no server of ours in the
middle. Nothing to breach, because there's nowhere for your text to go.

The keyboard asks for Full Access because that is the only way iOS lets a
keyboard read the snippets stored on your own device. KeepText uses it for
exactly that. Nothing is collected, nothing is transmitted, there's no
analytics — the app has no account system to send anything to in the first
place. You can export everything you've saved to a plain JSON file whenever
you like.


FREE, THEN ONE SMALL PURCHASE

Keep up to 20 snippets free for as long as you want. One small purchase
unlocks unlimited snippets, forever. No subscription. No trial that quietly
starts charging. No ads.


NO FOLDERS

You'll notice there's no filing system. That's deliberate. Search and
frequency do the organizing, so saving something costs you one tap instead of
one decision — which is the whole reason your snippets actually get saved

results.description:
copycopy is a completely local, subscription-free clipboard manager that saves the text, images, and files you copy so you never lose what matters.

How It Works
Copy something, and copycopy saves it. Use the copycopy keyboard, open the app, or set up Quick Capture to save your clipboard with Back Taps, the Action Button, or Control Center. No need to open the app or switch keyboards.

Your Clipboard Companion
Keep copycopy open on your iPhone while you work on your Mac or iPad. Browse, search, and filter your full clipboard history, then tap any item to copy it. With Universal Clipboard, it's instantly ready to paste on your other Apple device.

Smart Detection
copycopy automatically recognizes phone numbers, emails, URLs, addresses, tracking numbers, dates, passwords, credit cards, and code snippets. Tap for instant actions: call, message, open a link, track a package, or navigate to an address using your preferred apps.

Rich Text & Formatting
copycopy preserves rich text formatting: bold, italic, colors, and more. Paste back into Notes, Mail, or any app with formatting intact. Prefer plain text? Make it your default and reach rich text from the item menu, or strip formatting from any single item with one tap.

Files & Documents
Save PDFs, documents, and other files alongside your text and images. Files arrive with thumbnails, and the text inside PDFs becomes searchable.

Text Transforms
Transform copied text instantly: uppercase, lowercase, title case, URL encode/decode, Base64 encode/decode, strip HTML, remove line breaks, trim whitespace, and JSON format or minify. Copy the result or save it as a new item.

Stay Organized
Pin important items to the top. Mark items as Keepers so they're never auto-deleted. Add custom color-coded tags to organize your way. Combine filters to narrow by type, status, and tag at once. Sort by date, how often you copy something, name, size, or character count, and tap the same option again to reverse it. Or arrange your list by hand and keep it that way. Search your entire history with in-app and Spotlight search.

Bulk Editing
Select multiple items to tag, pin, rename, combine, transform, compress images, or delete in bulk.

Scan & Capture
Use the built-in camera to scan text from documents, signs, or anything in the real world. Drag and drop text or images directly into copycopy. Import photos from your library.

Your Keyboard, Your Clipboard
The copycopy keyboard gives you direct access to your clipboard history inside any app. Tap to paste, filter by type, and take actions, all without leaving what you're doing.

100% Private
Your data never leaves your device. That includes the AI: copycopy can name your snippets and describe your images, and every bit of it runs on this device. Each AI feature starts
switched off, and you can tell copycopy to leave any item alone. No accounts, no cloud sync, no analytics, no tracking, not even crash reporting. Lock the app behind Face ID or Touch ID. Passwords and credit cards are automatically hidden from Spotlight and the keyboard. Choose how quickly sensitive copies clear from the system clipboard, and how long saved cards are kept.

Choose Your Default Apps
Set your preferred apps for messaging, maps, email, browsers, and calendars, plus your preferred search engine. copycopy opens detected content in the apps you actually use.

Backup & Restore
Schedule automatic backups so your library is saved without you thinking about it, or export any time. Backups include your images, files, and formatting, and you can also export as JSON or CSV. Import or restore on another device to pick up right where you left off.

Free to Start
Your first 8 items are free with full functionality. Upgrade once to unlock up to 1,000 items. No subscription.

Find Unicode characters, make the keyboard your own, and write Japanese or Mandarin Chinese using familiar letter keys. Uniboard combines exact character entry, personal symbol pages, font previews and downloadable language resources for iPhone and iPad.

YOUR KEYS, YOUR ROWS
Edit letter, number and symbol key actions, arrange keys in rows, and align rows left, center, right or with space between keys. Existing configurations keep their saved appearance until edited. The extra number row belongs to the letter section. When all ten digits are available there and the layout fits, the symbol sections combine into one page without discarding saved key choices.

LANGUAGE CONVERSION
Japanese romaji and Mandarin pinyin dictionaries are optional downloads, not bundled with the keyboard. In Languages, download only what you want, then enable each mode separately. Nothing downloads automatically. Conversion runs on your device. Choose converted text or tap your original spelling to insert it unchanged. While composing, Space confirms without adding a space, and Return confirms without submitting; press again for the normal action.

Downloaded languages require Full Access so the keyboard can read language files shared by the app. This is local file access, not online typing. Direct Typing remains available without Full Access. Downloads require an internet connection.

YOUR WORDS
Add readings and preferred outputs in My Words, or preview and import a dictionary in Uniboard’s documented tab-separated text format. Imported dictionaries stay separate and can be enabled, disabled, exported or removed. Undo the last import without replacing your other dictionaries. Custom output preserves exact Unicode sequences, including emoji and combining accents.

BROWSE AND INSPECT
Search Unicode names, aliases, blocks or code points. Choose which emoji categories appear in the app and keyboard, including emoji search. Resize emoji in the app, and browse blocks from low to high or high to low code points. Hidden categories don’t remove saved favorites.

Inspect the text visible in the keyboard preview: code points, names, normalization forms and UTF-8/UTF-16 values. Move the cursor within the text the typing app exposes. Inspection does not read the whole document, and available context depends on the app.

FONTS AND IMAGES
Compare font styles by weight and width. Download a single style where available, or a clearly labeled shared file containing several styles. Set preferred fonts for code points, ranges or blocks. These choices affect Uniboard’s rendering, not another app’s fonts.

Copy visible preview text as an image with custom colors, transparency and resolution. Images paste as pictures where supported, not editable text.

KEEP YOUR SETUP
Export and import your configuration, or edit it in the app and validate before applying. Review replacements and resets, and undo the last configuration change. Language preferences and download references can be included, but dictionary and font files aren’t; missing downloads aren’t fetched automatically. Export custom dictionaries separately. Favorites and custom key text may be personal.

No account, ads or analytics. Uniboard’s keyboard does not send your typing or custom words to a server. Enable Uniboard in iOS Settings under General > Keyboard > Keyboards.
